mcqs.question:
Regarding the 12th State-Level Inter-District Women's Kabaddi tournament, consider the following statements:
Statement A: Chittoor district women's team won the tournament.
Statement B: Chittoor district women's team was the runner-up.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because the Krishna district women's team won the tournament. Statement B is true because Chittoor was the runner-up; confusing the winner with the runner-up is the trap.
